name: CoA Custom races stage 2: the races above 63 are created with their start, racials and Esteria appearance
contract: Stage 2 of the CoA Custom races takes the race ids 66-97 of the CoA Custom 1.5.1 package; CoA.CustomRaces.HighestRace is 97.

rev_20261012_14 gives them creation rows; 6_race_starts puts Highmountain (66) and Haranir (70) in Mulgore (map 1), Mechagnome (67) and Earthen (68) in Coldridge Valley (map 0) and Vulpera (74) in the Valley of Trials (map 1).
Every one of them learns its four package racials (spell_dbc 140000xy); the first of each is observed.

Highmountain and Earthen keep a sixth appearance byte (the outfit byte of CMSG_CHAR_CREATE), Haranir a uint64 after the stock packet with the HRC1 magic; characters.extraAppearance keeps it across a relog and UNIT_FIELD_PADDING / OBJECT_FIELD_PADDING carry it.

Races above 32 share the race mask bit of race ((id - 1) & 31) + 1: Saberon (97) the Human's, so Alliance quests such as A Threat Within (783); Vulpera (74) the Blood Elf's, so Horde quests such as Rude Awakening (363).
Native race, map, known spells, unit fields and CanTakeQuest are observed; EsteriaAppearance.dll's rendering is not.
